key_insight: Cancer is common across major cardiovascular disease groups, with pooled active cancer prevalence around 4%–6% and any cancer prevalence up to 14.1% in atrial fibrillation.
clinical_relevance: These findings support routine awareness, screening, and multidisciplinary coordination when managing patients with cardiovascular disease and potential cancer overlap.
method: Systematic review of PubMed, Web of Science, and Scopus (2010–July 2024)
Pooled prevalence estimates using one-step generalized linear mixed models
Included 676 studies with about 180 million participants
evidence_signal: The evidence base is large, with 59 studies contributing to the active-cancer analysis and prevalence estimates reported across multiple cardiovascular conditions.
watch_item: Heterogeneity across study populations, cancer definitions, and cardiovascular subgroups may limit direct comparison and real-world implementation.
paper_title: Prevalence of cancer in patients with cardiovascular diseases and risk factors: a systematic review and meta-analysis
